summary: GT Biopharma filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement of up to 8,277.778 shares of Series M 10% Convertible Preferred Stock with an aggregate stated value of $8,277,778, priced at $7,450,000, approximately a 10% discount. The offering includes 100% warrant coverage on an as-converted basis and a 30-day greenshoe for up to $33,333,333 stated value at $30,000,000. The preferred is convertible at any time subject to ownership limitations. No advisor or board recommendation was disclosed. The filing also includes amendments to the certificate of incorporation and modifications to rights of security holders. The key risk-arb angle is the dilutive overhang from the substantial greenshoe and warrant coverage, which could pressure the common stock price upon conversion and exercise.
